about: Predefined patrol areas for CMO Scenario Studio. 'kind' is 'sea' (naval/ASW patrol areas) or 'air' (CAP, AEW orbits, tanker tracks, training ranges). Points are [latitude, longitude] corners in order. Shapes are approximate operating boxes, not legal boundaries. Edit, add or remove areas; the studio uses your own copy of this file when it exists.

areas.name: UK airspace (London and Scottish FIRs)
areas.description: The UK flight information regions (London and Scottish FIR/UIR, same lateral limits): the whole area the UK air defence system polices. Official boundaries: UK AIP ENR 2.1, AIRAC 2026-10-29.

areas.name: QRA North area (Scottish FIR)
areas.description: The Scottish FIR: Scotland, Northern Ireland, the northern North Sea and the Atlantic approaches, covered by Quick Reaction Alert (North) from RAF Lossiemouth. Official boundary: UK AIP ENR 2.1, AIRAC 2026-10-29. The QRA split along the FIR boundary is a convention, not a published line.

areas.name: QRA South area (London FIR)
areas.description: The London FIR: England, Wales, the southern North Sea, the Channel and the South West approaches, covered by Quick Reaction Alert (South) from RAF Coningsby.
